name: Trole
source:
The current president of ORZ Corporate and leader of Thera. He lives life in secrecy and barely makes any public appearances which is definitely understandable considering his job. 

[spoiler]He is Belph's uncle and frighteningly enough, they share the same playful, mischievous personality; however, he seems to be on an entirely different level for he can even make Belph lose his composure.[/spoiler]
